items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one wide 16:9 2D pixel-art gameplay screenshot for an article about Eoul, a bright Korean folklore game world.
Primary request: Show the actual playable social-network simulation. The player selects the first listener, emotional tone and certainty of a rumor; colored paths preview how ten residents may distort it, and a night-spirit silhouette previews the aggregate result. This is about shaping propagation, not finding a liar.
Scene/backdrop: top-down Korean folklore town at dusk with connected market, guard post, well and houses.
Subject: exactly ten small resident sprites around town, each with a distinct trait icon. One real white magpie near the well. A selected merchant is outlined. Dotted rumor routes branch from the merchant; branch symbols change from one magpie to three coin-magpies or a painted-feather icon.
Composition/framing: central town map. Left compact message composer has icon rows for subject, emotion, certainty plus actions. Right panel shows a translucent noncombat night-spirit preview made of magpie and coin motifs. Top shows two time-slot tokens. Bottom timeline separates DAY propagation from NIGHT manifestation.
Style/medium: crisp readable 16-bit pixel art, small sprites, hanok town tiles, warm amber and indigo, clean node-route overlays, functional dark UI.
Lighting/mood: curious and slightly uncanny, not horror.
Text (verbatim): DAY 3, TELL, CORRECT, WAIT, NIGHT.
Constraints: no hidden-role accusation, vote, evidence board, detective murder, combat, cards, logo, watermark, or poster. The network route and predicted transformation must be central. Opaque full-bleed landscape.
visual_qa: 열 주민의 성향 아이콘과 선택한 첫 청자에서 갈라지는 다색 전파 경로 확인
실제 흰 까치, 세 마리로 과장된 판본, 깃털 판본과 NIGHT 결과 미리보기 확인
투표·증거판·전투 없이 전달 경로와 판본 변화가 중심인 화면 확인

items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one wide 16:9 2D pixel-art gameplay screenshot for an article about Eoul, a bright Korean folklore game world.
Primary request: Show the actual playable behavior-training simulator. The player demonstrates a conditional household behavior, rewards a correct response, and uses a deliberate counterexample so a small house-spirit learns when to act before choosing a home together.
Scene/backdrop: cozy side-view hanok training room opening onto a courtyard.
Subject: one trainer in simple hanbok, one small friendly fox-dog house spirit, one red floor mat, one brass warning bell, and one moving shadow dummy. The shadow crosses the red mat; the pet correctly touches the bell; the trainer offers a glowing praise token. Exactly one pet in the main room.
Composition/framing: actual game view. Right panel shows a three-part icon rule: shadow over red mat -> pet -> bell. Two examples below: green check for shadow on red mat; gray pause for ordinary visitor with no red mat. Bottom buttons DEMO, REWARD, IGNORE. Top trust and focus meters, no feeding or size meters. Small mutual-adoption request shows a night house and bell icon.
Style/medium: crisp charming 16-bit pixel art, square pixels, warm wood, cream paper, red mat, jade accents, clean practical UI.
Lighting/mood: patient, cozy, observant.
Text (verbatim): DEMO, REWARD, IGNORE, CUE.
Constraints: behavior learning and generalization are central. No capture, sale, creature combat, feeding loop, evolution, colony schedule, auto-battle, cards, logo, watermark, or poster. Opaque full-bleed landscape.
visual_qa: 그림자+붉은 깔개→집지킴이→종의 CUE 규칙과 성공·반례 두 행 확인
DEMO, REWARD, IGNORE 및 상호 입양 카드 확인
먹이·몸집·전투·작업표 없이 조건 행동 학습이 중심인 화면 확인
